The '''Jarastok family''' was a family that lived in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Several centuries before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Jarastok family killed a [[Unidentified Eteelan ancestor|member]] of the [[Eteelan family]], sparking a feud that would last until the entire Jarastok family was exterminated by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] over the course of a decade,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> a process that ended sometime before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /><ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Oppressor''}}</ref> Baras then took advantage of his newfound favor with the Eteelans to set the family upon his own rival [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jarastok family was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2012]] guide book for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
